clauses.requirement: End-outline marker lamp (para 6.13.9), other requirements: provided all other requirements are met, the mandatory or optional lamps visible from the front and those visible from the rear on the same side of the vehicle may be combined into one device; two of the lamps visible from the rear may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated in accordance with paragraph 5.7; the position of an end-outline marker lamp relative to the corresponding position lamp shall be such that the distance between the projections on a transverse vertical plane of the nearest points on the apparent surfaces in the direction of the respective reference axes is not less than 200 mm; additional lamps specified in paragraph 6.13.2(a) used to mark the rear end outline of the vehicle, trailer or semi-trailer shall be fitted so as to be visible within the fields of vision of the approved main rear-view devices for indirect vision.

Rear retro-reflector, non-triangular (para 6.14): the individual specifications of paragraphs 6.14.1 to 6.14.4 (presence, number, arrangement, position) shall be met by the rear retro-reflector of the lamp.

Presence of the non-triangular rear retro-reflector: it is mandatory on motor vehicles (including M1); on trailers it is optional provided it is grouped together with the other rear light-signalling devices.

Number of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors: two, type-approved as Class IA or IB retro-reflectors according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150; additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
Arrangement of the non-triangular rear retro-reflector: no special requirement.
Position of the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall comply with the requirements of paragraphs 6.14.4.1 (width) and 6.14.4.2 (height).

Position in width of the rear retro-reflector: the point on the illuminating surface farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes has no special requirement for M1 and N1 vehicles; for all other categories it shall be not less than 600 mm, which may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall vehicle width is less than 1,300 mm.

Position in height of the rear retro-reflector: above the ground not less than 250 mm and not more than 900 mm; not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s); up to 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
